entries.label: Sealed
entries.description: Asphalt, spray seal (chip seal) or concrete.

osm.note: Also covers paving stones and setts.

entries.label: Unsealed
entries.description: Not sealed, with the material not recorded. Most road authority datasets say only sealed or unsealed, so seed imports use this code until a contributor reports the material.

entries.label: Gravel
entries.description: A formed road surfaced with compacted gravel, crushed rock or fine gravel.

osm.note: Used on highway=track ways: a firm gravel track.

entries.label: Dirt or natural earth
entries.description: An unformed or lightly formed track on the natural soil, without added gravel.

osm.note: Used on highway=track ways: mostly soil with little hard material.

entries.label: Sand
entries.description: A track over sand, such as a beach or desert track, where a vehicle can bog without lowered tyre pressures.

osm.note: Used on highway=track ways: soft, uncompacted material.

entries.label: Clay or black soil
entries.description: Clay or black soil that sets hard when dry and becomes slippery or impassable when wet.

entries.label: Rock
entries.description: Exposed bedrock, rock steps or loose stones larger than gravel.

entries.label: Mud
entries.description: A track that is mud for much of the year, such as a track through swamp or rainforest.
